name: sugarcraft/sugar-async
description: Shared async utilities for SugarCraft — cancellation tokens, subscriptions, timeout/deadline combinators, fan-in, debounce/throttle handles, retry, and a bounded cache-aside store, built on ReactPHP.

suggest.ext-uv: Drives the faster ReactPHP loop, but its deadline clock refreshes once per iteration: timers armed after a long synchronous idle are already overdue. Test suites that bound waits with timers need sugar-testing's LoopPin::pinStableClock() from tests/bootstrap.php (see the README 'Testing with AsyncOps' section).
suggest.ext-pcntl: Delivers SIGINT so a loop-driving program can map Ctrl-C onto CancellationSource::cancel() as ordinary teardown instead of a stack trace (see the README 'Cancellation' sketch).
